_comment: Pinned toolchain for this repo's evidence, checked (not merely recorded)
before any PVT point is simulated.
pdk_version        EXACT match against the first line of the variant
dir's SOURCES marker. The hash IS the device
models: a different revision silently yields
numbers no other record is comparable with.
Install it with:
pip install 'ciel==2.6.1'
ciel enable --pdk-family gf180mcu -l default \
f6eeac7dad085ffcc829ccfd721f7b4ce39edcf7
ngspice_min_major  floor, not an exact match -- newer ngspice is
allowed and recorded; older is refused. 42 is the
oldest toolchain this repo verifies against (the
Ubuntu 24.04 apt package CI installs); dev boxes
on newer ngspice pass the same pin.
python_min         floor, as 'major.minor'. The analog harness is
stdlib-only; the floor is what CI's runner and
dev boxes are held to.
A drift is fatal by default; --allow-toolchain-drift overrides it and
stamps the drift into every record written under it.
